title: (No AI) Judge dismisses Sam Altman’s sister’s sexual abuse lawsuit
author: Richard Lawler
content:
![An image of Sam Altman, OpenAI CEO.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/12/STK201_SAM_ALTMAN_CVIRGINIA_D.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

On Tuesday, US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the [lawsuit](https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/69520118/altman-v-altman/?filed_after=&filed_before=&entry_gte=&entry_lte=&order_by=desc) Ann Altman [filed last year alleging that her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, had sexually abused her](https://www.theverge.com/2025/1/7/24338736/sam-altman-sexual-abuse-lawsuit-ann-sister) throughout her childhood. As reported earlier by _[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/20/judge-dismisses-sam-altman-sister-lawsuit)_, the judge wrote that over the past year, Ann had failed to appear for an independent medical examination or meet other deadlines despite warnings that it would result in the case being dismissed.

title: (No AI) Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
author: Emma Roth
content:
![An image showing Gemini’s Personal Intelligence feature on a car’s display](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/google-gemini-personal-intelligence.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Google is [bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-auto-cars-with-google-built-in-gemini-personal-intelligence/) in your car. With this update, Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search.

As an example, Google says you can ask Gemini about your flight status if you're driving to the airport. The AI assistant can pull your flight details from a confirmation message in Gmail and then use that information to look up the status. You can also ask Gemini to "take me to my doctor's appointment" instead of pulling up directions manually, or ask it to "find the car wash from the photo I t …
